name: Opportune Spell Assault
body:
You punish opponents leaving themselves open with a frenzy of touch attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast spells, Combat reflexes, BAB +15, Quicken Spell or Quickened Magic arcana, Opportune Spellstrike.

Benefit(s): When using a touch spell that allows multiple attacks, you may deliver as many Opportune Spellstrike attacks as you have Attacks of Opportunity. If you have the spellstrike class feature, you may deliver these attacks with a melee weapon.
